## 🏢 About Moinsen Dev

**Moinsen Dev** is a Hamburg-based software consultancy specializing in cutting-edge Flutter development and AI-powered solutions. Founded by Ulrich Diedrichsen, we combine 40 years of software engineering experience with the latest in artificial intelligence and mobile technology.

### 🎯 What We Do

We transform complex business problems into elegant technical solutions through:

- 🚀 **Flutter Development** - Cross-platform apps that delight users
- 🤖 **AI & Agentic Systems** - Intelligent solutions that think and act
- 🏗️ **Domain-Driven Architecture** - Software that speaks your business language
- ⚡ **Vibe Coding** - AI-enhanced development for maximum productivity

## 💼 Our Services

### Flutter Excellence
- **Multiplatform Apps** - One codebase for iOS, Android, Web, Desktop
- **Performance Optimization** - 60fps smooth experiences

- **LLM Integration** - OpenAI, Claude, custom models

### Consulting & Architecture
- **Technical Leadership** - CTO-level guidance
- **Architecture Reviews** - Ensure scalability and maintainability
- **Team Training** - Level up your developers
- **Code Audits** - Identify and fix technical debt
